title: Cursor introduces Cursor Start, a ~$7 monthly subscription exclusive to India, its third-largest market, priced below its standard $20 Pro monthly subscription (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Cursor introduces Cursor Start, a ~$7 monthly subscription exclusive to India, its third-largest market, priced below its standard $20 Pro monthly subscription — Weeks before its expected acquisition by SpaceX closes, AI coding startup Cursor is making its biggest push into India yet …
